question:
Select the most appropriate antonym of the given word.

Superfluous
solution:
The correct answer is: **Essential**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Superfluous"** means something unnecessary, especially through being more than enough or excessive. (अत्यधिक, अनावश्यक)
 
 
• **Example:** The report was filled with superfluous information that made it difficult to focus on the main points.
 
 
 
• **"Essential"** refers to something absolutely necessary or indispensable. (आवश्यक)
 
 
• **Example:** Water is essential for the survival of all living beings.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'superfluous'** is **'essential'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Essential**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Redundant** (अतिरिक्त): Something that is no longer needed or useful, often repetitive in nature.
 
 
• **Example:** The new software made many of the old processes redundant.
 
 
 
• **Unnecessary** (अनावश्यक): Not needed or required; superfluous.
 
 
• **Example:** The meeting was filled with unnecessary discussions that wasted everyone’s time.
 
 
 
• **Extra** (अतिरिक्त): More than what is usual, expected, or necessary.
 
 
• **Example:** She packed some extra clothes for the trip in case of emergencies.
